The sources report actual pump-and-dump losses in the surrounding fraud, including SVT’s named 600,000 SEK victim. They do not establish the portion materially caused by the particular AI advertisements or that named victim’s AI entry path. The alternative S2 criterion requires independently evidenced low and readily remediable AI-associated economic disruption; S3 requires material but bounded AI-associated livelihood or organisational loss. No such apportioned consequence is established here. The missing fact is material AI contribution and consequence allocation, not a USD conversion alone. Broad losses are not erased or automatically assigned to all synthetic portrayals.
